title: A manual loan repayment or 'mark recovered' entered while the month's payroll is processed but not yet approved does not stop the payslip deduction, so the employee repays twice.

title: The idle timeout says 'You have been logged out' but logs nobody out, so pressing F5 or opening a new tab carries on as the previous user

title: Bullet lists in Terms & Conditions show as numbered lists (and indents/alignment are lost) in the read-only T&C viewer and on the printed PO
scenario: A merchandiser writes T&C with a bullet list in the editor; react-quill-new 3.8.3 saves getSemanticHTML() (<ul><li>). The sanitiser added for U206 re-emits quill.root.innerHTML, which in Quill 2 is <ol><li data-list="bullet"> with indent/alignment as ql-indent-N / ql-align-* classes. Those are only styled under .ql-editor (quill.snow.css), and neither the read-only div (.rich-text-readonly) nor the print .terms-content has that class, so a user without update rights and every supplier receiving the PO see 1. 2. 3. instead of bullets and lose nesting. The .rich-text-readonly list CSS is also only injected when an editor (edit mode) is mounted.
fix: Have the sanitiser return quill.getSemanticHTML() (what the editor stores), or keep root markup but render it inside a .ql-editor container in both the viewer and the print; move the read-only CSS out of the edit-mode <style> block.
visible: visible: bullets, nesting and alignment render as the author typed them (restores the pre-U206 look)
note: Verified in node_modules: quill 2.0.3 formats/list.js ListContainer.tagName='OL' with data-list; react-quill-new lib/index.js:47 onChange passes getSemanticHTML. Commit 1bc1508 claimed byte-identical output; that holds only for HTML already in Quill root markup, not for what the current editor saves. Arguably P1 since it is on every PO print with a bulleted T&C. Raised to P1 by the lead: a regression from the U206 gate fix that shows on every printed PO with bulleted terms. Verified: react-quill-new saves getSemanticHTML() (lib/index.js:47), and sanitizeRichTextWith returns quill.root.innerHTML.

title: A quick vertical scroll of the notification list on a tablet can delete a notification with no undo
scenario: On a tablet the user flicks the notification list up; the finger drifts 15 px sideways in ~25 ms. touchmove marks isDragging once |deltaX|>10 without comparing it to vertical movement, and touchend triggers when velocity |deltaX|/elapsed > 0.5 px/ms, so 15/25 = 0.6 fires the swipe-left branch and calls onDelete - the notification is deleted on the server with no confirm or undo.
fix: Lock the gesture to horizontal only when |deltaX| clearly exceeds |deltaY|, require a minimum distance alongside the velocity test, and offer undo before deleting.

title: Two finishing users receiving parts of one sewing note at the same time overwrite each other's receipt, because the receipt is sent as an absolute cumulative quantity with no version
scenario: Note GI-12 has 200 pcs of size M. Users A and B both open the drawer and see 0 already received. A records 120 and the UI sends receivedQty = 0 + 120. Sewing now shows 50 of 200 received after 170 pieces arrived, and the note is offered again for 150.

title: A confirmed deduction keeps its old amount after the bill's lines change, so the debit note and net payable come out wrong
scenario: A Garment Process PO line: 500 pcs invoiced at Rs 4.50 (2,250.00), 475 accepted. Propose deductions gives REJECTION_CHARGE 112.50 + GST, and the verifier confirms it. The clerk then corrects the vendor's invoice quantity to 480 (the vendor actually billed 480), so the line's rejection amount is now 22.50. mockUpdateBill re-derives the lines but leaves the confirmed deduction at 112.50. A second 'Propose' skips that line and type because confirmed rows are 'ruled', and no exception compares confirmed system deductions with the current line figures. Net payable = 2,160 + GST - (112.50 + GST): the vendor is under-paid by Rs 90 + GST, and the VDN prints 112.50 (25 pcs) when only 5 billed pieces were rejected.
fix: Store the line figure each system deduction was proposed from, and raise a BLOCK exception (or reset the row to PROPOSED) when a save changes it. Add the case to jobWorkBillGolden.json so Stage 2's Java carries the same rule.

title: The bill calculator rounds money with the Number.EPSILON trick, which rounds some half-paisa amounts down where the PO calculator and Java HALF_UP round up
scenario: r2 = Math.round((x + EPSILON) * 100) / 100 only corrects values below about 1. GST at 5% on a taxable value of 10,240.90 is 512.045: the bill computes 512.04, while poValue (round2) and BigDecimal HALF_UP give 512.05. So the job-work PO and its bill disagree by a paisa, TAX_MISMATCH figures are off, and the golden file the Stage 2 Java must 'reproduce' encodes binary-float rounding that HALF_UP will not match. Other cases: 25.5 units x Rs 1.49 = 37.995 becomes 37.99, and 250.5 x 1.17 = 293.085 becomes 293.08.
fix: Use round2/round3 from jobWorkPoCalc (decimal-string half-up) in jobWorkBillCalc and vendorDebitNotePrint, and add half-paisa cases to the golden file.
visible: visible: some amounts change by Rs 0.01
